commitSubject: ITSMFT: accept normalized measurement and TimeFrame contracts
note: Intervening commits since the baseline-test wave changed tests, unused new layout primitives, and documentation only; production ITS/MFT tracking code on this commit is still the pre-refactor baseline implementation.

simDigiStack.source: installed alibuild package, not built from this commit
simDigiStack.note: o2-sim / o2-sim-digitizer-workflow are simulation/digitization infrastructure, not part of the ITS/MFT tracking refactor under test; per task instructions they were taken from the installed stack. The '+local changes' suffix means this installed build has uncommitted local modifications on top of cf19214f6e -- exact diff not captured.

recoAssessmentStack.source: built from this commit in a dedicated CMake/ninja build directory
recoAssessmentStack.additionalPluginLibsNote: These are dlopen'd DPL plugins (AOD run-summary support, CCDB fetch backend) not linked at build time by the reco/reader executables; a ninja build targeting only the executables silently omits them, which for CCDBSupport specifically breaks condition fetching (not just log noise) -- see README known-issues.

fixture.resolvedConditionTimestampNote: o2-sim/DPL derive this historical timestamp from runNumber=303000; it is what all CCDB condition queries below actually used, not conditionNotAfterMs (which is only an upper bound on object creation time).
fixture.ccdbObjectsFetchedNote: Recovered from workflow logs (grep for 'ccdb reads'); every ETag matched exactly between initial fixture generation and every replay run (verified for canonical-1), confirming the pinned run number + condition-not-after bound reproduce the same condition set without a local CCDB snapshot. No local CCDB snapshot was committed or prepared; reproduction depends on these objects remaining available at these ETags on alice-ccdb.cern.ch.
retainedFixtureFiles: o2clus_its.root (compact clusters + patterns + ROF + MC labels)
mftclusters.root (compact clusters + patterns + ROF + MC labels)
o2simdigitizerworkflow_configuration.ini (HBFUtils/run provenance, required for replay -- see README)
o2trac_its.root, mfttracks.root (initial-pass tracks; baseline OUTPUT, not input -- kept for reference only, not the reusable fixture)
fixture.notCommitted: All of the above are outside the git worktree under /private/tmp/o2-itsmft-gate0/ and were not committed. Only generate_fixture.sh, replay_tracking.sh, extract_metrics.C, this manifest, and baseline_summary.md are committed.

pilotProjection.boundCheck: 34s and <700MB for 2 events projects to well under the 20min/2GB bound for 20 events; proceeded automatically per policy §4.

replay.knownIssueHbfutilsConfig: See README.md 'HBFUtils ini handling'. --hbfutils-config pointed at an absolute ini path hung o2-its-reco-workflow indefinitely before spawning any device (root cause not identified further given time budget); the working form copies the fixture's ini into REPLAY_DIR under its default relative name and omits --hbfutils-config entirely.
replay.clusterRofBranchOnlyNote: --cluster-rof-branch-only is required on both o2-its-reco-workflow and o2-mft-reco-workflow during replay: their embedded cluster-writer device (present even with --clusters-from-upstream) otherwise requires a CLUSTERSMC2ROF input the cluster-reader-workflow does not provide, and the merged topology fails validation.
replay.pipeFlagNote: Only the last command in a DPL '|' pipe may carry -b/--run; the upstream reader must be invoked bare so it dumps its workflow spec via stdout for merging instead of running as its own standalone driver.
